summary: After two days of gains led by IT and realty, Indian shares head into Friday with US markets shut for Thanksgiving and oil prices climbing back on Gulf supply worries.

detail.leaders: IT and realty, which led Thursday's gains
detail.laggards: Auto, FMCG and consumer durables, which saw selling on Thursday
detail.tone: A forward-looking read for Friday. Slightly more cautious than the close, as higher oil prices and a thin global session temper the two-day rally.
